normative_assessment: Length/start/delete conversion, argument presence and safe-integer overflow precede species. ArraySpeciesCreate ignores constructor for non-Arrays; null species defaults, but a null constructor fails. Use the saved realm intrinsic and Construct with exactly one length argument.

Deleted elements use separate live Has/Get and own data definitions. The result length Set runs before source edits. Species may return source, another Array, mapped arguments or any supported object; no distinctness or stale descriptor assumption is safe.

Shrinking moves ascending then deletes tail descending; growth moves descending. Missing entries delete destinations. Source assignments and both length Sets are strict; earlier effects survive throws. There is no iterator protocol or rollback.

Create each movement from/to key before its Has/Get; create the deleted-output key after successful source Get. Default oversized ArrayCreate fails early, but actual source Array overflow can leave ordinary key 4294967295 before the final length RangeError.

findings.finding: subprocess.run with timeout terminates/reaps its immediate Cargo or Python child, without owning a new process group. Descendant rustc, test, runner, broker or worker processes can outlive the timeout. The inherited ci_test_runner only launches its child and provides no descendant cleanup guarantee.
findings.recommended_change: Start an owned session/group, use waitid NOWAIT to observe exit while leader identity is retained, kill the group before the first reaping wait, and retain bounded cleanup/failure results.
